# The Witten index

Claims from wiphy.org for the planned `PhyslibAlpha.QFT.WittenIndex` module.

claims.name: wittenIndex_counts_susyVacua
claims.statement: The Witten index counts the number of supersymmetric vacua.

sources.title: The supersymmetric index in four dimensions

claims.name: wittenIndex_vanishes_pairedStates
claims.statement: The number of bosonic and fermionic supersymmetric ground states are equal, so the Witten index vanishes: $\mathrm{Tr}(-1)^F = 0$.
